baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired speech and following forms at words 2/8 and 4/10 connect one path to divine descent at word 6 and the other to finding the fathers at words 12/14.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two public claims install rival objects of the same following action. One object arrives by divine delivery; the other is encountered as an already occupied ancestral position. Repetition makes the issue not whether to follow, but what can authorize a chain of following.

activation_trace.role: Vocalized saying makes both clauses public claims and supplies the contest's dialogic frame.
Trailing and taking as precedent supplies the shared action whose object changes between the two claims.
Caused descent as delivery marks the first authority as something made to arrive from God.
Finding and encountering supplies the second claim's only stated access to its norm.
Fatherhood and nurture identify the encountered precedent as a genealogical relation rather than an independently stated warrant.

changed_reading.before: A command to obey revelation is rejected in favor of ancestral custom.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages two rival authorization chains using the same act of following: delivered authority versus an inherited position whose having been found is made to function as proof.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The counterfactual at words 16-21 joins the devil, his calling, punishment, and the blaze to the earlier repeated act of following.
baseline_models.mechanism: A remote and deviant caller inclines hearers through speech; following then carries an attached liability, and the named endpoint renders that liability as both ignition and consuming frenzy. The counterfactual exposes destination as a test of the guide.

activation_trace.role: Distance and severance make the caller one who leads from a position of disconnection.
Deviation, opposition, and harshness characterize the call's bent trajectory.
Calling that inclines by speech supplies the mechanism that recruits the followers.
The liability that adheres to following connects chosen allegiance to an ensuing claim upon the follower.
Painful penalty supplies the consequence attached to the recruited trajectory.
Kindling and ignition materialize the endpoint as a process set alight.
Frenzy and consuming distress add an affective runaway quality to the ignited endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The devil merely invites them to punishment in a fire.
changed_reading.after: The verse tests allegiance by trajectory: an inclining call creates a following with its own liability, and its destination reveals the call as a process already tending toward ignition and frenzy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence presents distracting discourse as displacement from a path, then depicts recitation meeting failed comprehension and ear-weight. This revises the ancestral reply from neutral disagreement into a verbal-auditory defense that keeps an inherited following in place.

activation_trace.role: Saying as belief or doctrine lets the reply function as a settled position, not only a momentary utterance.
Following as precedent is the behavior protected by that settled reply.
Being occupied by one thing away from another supplies discourse's diversionary function.
A traversable extended path makes diversion a change of route rather than a merely bad topic.
Hearing as comprehension and compliance identifies the reception that the hearer withholds.
Weight in the ear supplies a blocking image for the reply's resistant reception.

structural_cues: 31:6 orders purchased discourse, displacement from a path, lack of knowledge, and mockery as one sequence.
31:7 moves from recitation to turning away, feigned non-hearing, and ear-weight before naming punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies diversionary discourse, route-loss, withheld comprehension, and ear-weight; I infer that the focus reply performs the same shielding function. Alternatively, 31:6-7 may describe a different audience posture without specifying the function of the reply in 31:21.

changed_reading.before: The speakers state a preference for ancestral precedent.
changed_reading.after: Their statement can function as an auditory shield: circulating doctrine blocks reception and preserves the route already being followed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated descent is materially coupled to water, rain, and growth. The unspecified object sent down in the focus ayah therefore acquires a generative profile: it is delivered provision whose authority is shown by what responsive reception can bring forth, not only by a top-down command.

activation_trace.role: Caused descent and delivery anchors the focus object as something God makes arrive.
The same delivered descent is concretized in a water sequence and supplies the material analogy.
Water itself supplies the receiving medium of the contextual descent.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the visible effect that follows reception of the descent.
Life-giving rain descending from the sky reinforces descent as provision rather than bare vertical motion.

structural_cues: 31:10 orders divine descent, water, sprouting, and diverse growth as a causal material sequence.
31:34 again places divine sending-down directly beside rain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated descent-water-growth coupling; I carry that material causal profile back to the unspecified focus object and infer productive reception. A live alternative restricts the focus object to verbal revelation and treats the rain sequences only as parallel divine acts.

changed_reading.before: What God sent down is an authoritative message to be obeyed.
changed_reading.after: What God sent down is also figured as arriving provision: following it means receiving a generative descent rather than remaining fixed on inherited ground.

context_deltas.mechanism: The parent-child sequence preserves transmitted obligation and close companionship while explicitly refusing parental obedience under associating pressure and redirecting following to another path. It partitions care for parents from granting parenthood authority over truth.

activation_trace.role: Fatherhood and nurture anchor the focus appeal in a real relation of care rather than an abstract old custom.
Taking another as precedent names the authority claim that the context partitions from care.
A charge connected and transmitted to another supplies a genuine intergenerational obligation.
Parents defined through birth keep the relational basis of that obligation explicit.
Compliance and obedience name precisely what is withheld when parental pressure crosses the stated boundary.
Close accompanying preserves social care after obedience has been refused.
A new instruction to take precedent redirects following rather than abolishing it.
The traversable path gives redirected following a chosen route distinct from parental pressure.

structural_cues: 31:13 begins with a father's admonition to a son, so parentally transmitted speech is not rejected as a class.
31:14-15 sequence parental burden, gratitude, refusal of obedience in association, continued companionship, and an alternate path to follow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies simultaneous parental obligation, bounded non-obedience, companionship, and redirected following; I infer that 31:21 targets genealogy used as epistemic warrant, not filial relation itself. Alternatively, the boundary in 31:15 may apply narrowly to explicit association rather than all inherited claims.

changed_reading.before: The ayah condemns following one's fathers.
changed_reading.after: The ayah separates two inheritances: parental care remains binding, while parenthood cannot convert an inherited position into a truth-authorizing path.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah supplies three absent warrants for disputation about God: disclosed knowledge, route-giving guidance, and an illuminating written source. The focus appeal to what was found upon the fathers then reads as a substitution for all three, not merely a preference for age.

activation_trace.role: Finding and encountering identifies the empirical-looking act promoted into a warrant by the reply.
Following turns that promoted encounter into a governing precedent.
Twisted or entangled contention supplies the argumentative setting directly before the focus exchange.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the first warrant explicitly absent from the dispute.
Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies the second absent warrant and a route test for following.
Ordered written discourse supplies the third absent warrant in durable textual form.
Illumination makes that written warrant capable of disclosure rather than mere inscription.

structural_cues: 31:20 is immediately adjacent and ends with a threefold negated warrant before 31:21 supplies the ancestral answer.
The focus reply states discovery of a prior position but no knowledge, guidance, or written illumination for it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency and a three-part warrant deficit; I infer that the ancestral formula fills the argumentative vacancy. Alternatively, the two ayat may list neighboring refusal types without making the triad a formal test of the reply.

changed_reading.before: The reply is wrong because it is traditionalist.
changed_reading.after: The reply is diagnostically unwarranted: mere encounter with an inherited position is made to stand in for disclosed knowledge, directional guidance, and illuminating record.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah replaces being found upon an ancestral position with active orientation and grasp. Surrendered direction, enacted good, holding, and trustworthiness form a deliberate attachment whose reliability lies ahead in its support, not behind in who occupied it first.

activation_trace.role: Encountering something already there supplies the passive inherited placement that is revised by the next ayah.
Following as precedent anchors the revision in the focus choice of attachment.
Handing over and releasing a thing supplies deliberate entrustment rather than accidental location.
Direction and orientation turn attachment toward a chosen destination.
Doing what is good makes the orientation enacted rather than merely asserted.
Holding and restraining supplies the active grip that replaces passive inherited placement.
Trust and repose in a reliable support supply the grip's criterion of stability.

structural_cues: 31:21's spatial construction places the fathers on an inherited object; 31:22 shifts to directed surrender and active grasping.
The branchless handhold root ع ر و at 31:22 word 10 is used only as a structural material cue between grasping and firmness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies passive discovery-on, directed surrender, good action, grasp, and reliable support; I infer a contrast between inherited location and tested attachment. Alternatively, the two spatial constructions may be complementary exhortations rather than a deliberate replacement sequence.

changed_reading.before: The choice is between one doctrine and an ancestral doctrine.
changed_reading.after: The choice is also between modes of attachment: remaining where ancestors were found versus orienting oneself, acting, and gripping a support whose reliability can bear weight.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later question elicits the spoken answer that God created the heavens and earth, yet the sequence closes by denying knowledge to most respondents. Verbal confession can therefore coexist with failure to let that confession govern what one follows.

activation_trace.role: Saying as creed or doctrinal position anchors the distinction between professed belief and governing allegiance.
Following as precedent supplies the practical allegiance that can diverge from confession.
Audible answer supplies explicit confession about the creator within the later exchange.
Origination and bringing creation into existence specify the proposition the respondents acknowledge.
Disclosure to a knower, explicitly negated at the close, exposes the confession's failure to become operative understanding.

structural_cues: 31:25 sequences question, their answer naming God, a commanded response, and then the negation of knowledge.
The same saying root frames both the focus refusal and the later correct-sounding answer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies correct creator-confession followed by negated knowledge; I infer that knowledge here includes allowing the confessed creator to govern allegiance. Alternatively, the negated knowledge may concern gratitude or consequences rather than the practical force of the confession itself.

changed_reading.before: The focus opponents reject God in favor of their fathers.
changed_reading.after: They may verbally acknowledge God while assigning actual governing force to ancestry; the conflict is between confession and operative following, not simply belief and unbelief.

context_deltas.mechanism: The calling relation changes direction across the context: the devil calls humans toward ignition, humans call what lacks truth, and under an engulfing wave humans call God with purified allegiance. The focus warning becomes a reversible circuit of address and attachment whose object can change when inherited mediation loses its grip.

activation_trace.role: Calling that inclines by speech anchors the initial vector from the devil toward the hearers.
Deviation and opposition characterize the first caller's trajectory.
Ignition supplies the endpoint toward which the initial call inclines.
The same inclining address now has humans as callers and reverses their role in the circuit.
Loss of truth and stability characterizes the object of that human calling.
Calling is redirected to God when danger strips away ordinary supports.
Interpenetrating turbulence supplies the crisis pressure that precedes redirected address.
Purification after admixture supplies the removal of competing attachments in the crisis call.
Obedience and submission identify what becomes purified, linking calling back to the focus question of following.

structural_cues: 31:21 has a caller moving humans toward the blaze; 31:30 makes humans call apart from God; 31:32 makes the endangered humans call God.
The wave episode places purified allegiance inside crisis and then narrates survival onto land, making orientation temporally reversible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three call configurations and a crisis purification; I infer a circuit in which address both expresses and recruits allegiance, with pressure capable of reversing it. Alternatively, the episodes may simply contrast true and false objects of prayer without implying a recurring social circuit.

changed_reading.before: The focus contains a one-way satanic invitation.
changed_reading.after: The satanic call is one phase in a reversible economy of calling: followers can become callers of the unstable, while crisis can uncover a direct, purified allegiance beneath inherited mediation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch of following carries a liability, but the later parent-child symmetry denies that either generation can stand in for the other. Following fathers can therefore transmit a path without transferring responsibility back to those fathers; the descendant remains exposed to the path's endpoint.

activation_trace.role: An attached claim or liability makes inherited following consequential for the one who follows.
Fatherhood anchors the attempted authorization in the same intergenerational relation later denied substitutive force.
Penalty names the exposure that cannot be shifted along the genealogy.
Protection by repelling harm supplies the function that the kinship relation is warned not to provide.
One thing standing in another's place is placed under explicit negation, blocking transferred settlement.
Parenthood from birth supplies both sides of the symmetrical non-substitution.

structural_cues: 31:33 symmetrically negates parent-for-child and child-for-parent substitution before warning against deception.
The focus moves from fathers as precedent to an individualized destination, while 31:33 removes genealogical rescue at that destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following-as-liability, threatened penalty, and explicit intergenerational non-substitution; I infer that ancestral authorization cannot relocate the follower's consequence onto ancestors. Alternatively, 31:33 may state general final responsibility without specifically commenting on inherited precedent.

changed_reading.before: Following the fathers is a mistaken appeal to authority.
changed_reading.after: It is also an attempt at impossible risk transfer: ancestry can hand down a route, but neither ancestor nor descendant can absorb the other's liability at its endpoint.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping from و ج د to ج د د and combines two branch images across that mapped root. It remains anchored in the focus finding, following, spatial placement, and fathers; downstream prose should present it only as a branch-triggered spatial overlay, not as the lexical meaning or etymology of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 10-14 join following, finding, the prepositional placement upon something, and the fathers.

activation_trace.role: Tracing one mark after another supplies motion along a pre-existing route.
Visible tracks and patterned lines from the alternate mapped root supply the image of an already scored route.
Grandfatherhood from the same alternate mapped root binds that scored route specifically to ancestry.
Fatherhood and nurture keep the exploratory track attached to the verse's explicit genealogy.

changed_reading.before: They copy practices held by their fathers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they enter an ancestral groove: finding predecessors already on a marked route is mistaken for evidence that the route itself is sound.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it activates the packet's alternate ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping; it must not be rendered as a lexical claim that saying means smallness. It remains worth carrying because 31:24 supplies an actual ق ل ل occurrence with the same mapped root shortly after the focus; downstream prose should label it a split-root resonance that makes the counterclaim feel scant and unstable before consequence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The paired sayings at words 2 and 8 carry the packet's explicit alternate mapped target, while the reply attempts to support continued ancestral following.

activation_trace.role: Scantness and small measure from the alternate focus mapping make the counterclaim an exploratorily thin support.
Movement with little stability from the alternate mapping gives that verbal support a rattling, unsettled quality.
The contextual root's actual smallness qualifies the intervening enjoyment and activates the alternate focus target temporally.

changed_reading.before: Their spoken counterclaim sounds like a firm inherited certainty.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root resonance, the counterclaim is a scant, unstable support whose apparent firmness lasts only briefly before the liability of its following is exposed.

strongest_changes: The parent-child sequence separates durable filial care from obedience and truth-authorizing ancestry.
The warrant triad in 31:20 turns ancestral discovery into a failed substitute for knowledge, guidance, and illuminating record.
The active orientation and grip of 31:22 replace inherited placement with tested attachment.
The confession in 31:25 shows that correct God-language can coexist with ancestry governing actual following.
The non-substitution of generations in 31:33 makes the liability of ancestral following individually borne.
summary.what_was_special: The trace preserves multiple mechanisms without collapsing them: epistemic warrant, relational partition, material descent and growth, bodily attachment, reversible calling, and non-transferable liability. Its most unusual activations come from packet-supplied split mappings that overlay an ancestral track and a scant, unstable counterclaim while remaining explicitly contained.
remaining_uncertainties: The productive rain analogy may illuminate the focus descent without specifying the exact content of its object.
The call circuit is a reader-supplied causal synthesis across distinct scenes.
The ج د د and ق ل ل overlays are legitimate packet activations but remain form-distant and must not be promoted to lexical derivations.
